title.zh-TW: 金管會11/23起全面禁止平盤下放空，並祭五項穩市措施
title.en: FSC bans all below-prior-close short selling from Nov. 23 in five-step package

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，金管會宣布23日起上市櫃股票及TDR全面禁止以低於前一日收盤價融券及借券賣出（券商避險除外），融券保證金成數由130%提高至150%，暫停受理券商新發行認售權證，並鼓勵上市公司買回庫藏股、出借機構暫停出借並提前召回。金管會稱這是2015年以來首次全面平盤下禁空。經濟日報指此為本輪第五波措施。
summary.en: CNA reports the FSC will, from Nov. 23, bar short sales of listed and OTC stocks and TDRs below the prior close (broker hedging exempt), raise short-sale margin from 130% to 150%, suspend new put-warrant applications, and encourage buybacks and lenders to halt lending and recall shares. The FSC says it is the first full ban since 2015; Economic Daily News calls it the fifth round of curbs.

impact.zh-TW: 限空措施可能壓低空方賣壓與融券量，但無法改變美國AI股修正的根本因素；週一起實施效果與成交量變化有待觀察，屬推論。
impact.en: The curbs may reduce short-selling pressure and borrowing, but cannot change the US AI-stock correction driving the slide; their effect and volume impact from Monday remain to be seen. This is an inference.

sources.publisher: 經濟日報 via 聯合新聞網 UDN

title.zh-TW: 台股單週重挫7,641點、跌17.5%，國安基金稱已進場護盤
title.en: TAIEX loses 7,641 points (17.5%) in a week; stabilization fund says it is buying

summary.zh-TW: 聯合新聞網報導，國安基金21日發布新聞稿表示已進場護盤、外資賣超已縮小，將視情況持續因應。國安基金將本波下跌歸因於美國AI監管可能收緊、龐大資本支出回收疑慮、個別公司因素及融資風險，並引述主計總處預估今年GDP成長11.05%及出口、訂單創新高等基本面數據。
summary.en: UDN reports the National Stabilization Fund said on Nov. 21 that it has entered the market, foreign net selling has narrowed and it will act further as needed. It blamed the slide on possibly tighter US AI regulation, doubts over returns on heavy capex, company-specific issues and financing risk, citing an official 11.05% GDP growth estimate and record exports and orders.

impact.zh-TW: 官方護盤與基本面喊話有助穩定信心，但護盤規模未公布；國安基金提及的GDP屬官方預估，市場仍取決於美國AI股走勢，屬推論。
impact.en: Official buying and upbeat fundamentals may steady sentiment, but the fund's size of purchases was not disclosed; the GDP figure is an official estimate and the market still hinges on US AI stocks. This is an inference.

title.zh-TW: 輝達單日重挫14%、連7週收黑，為金融危機後最長紀錄
title.en: Nvidia sinks 14% in a day, posting a seventh straight weekly loss

summary.zh-TW: 中央社舊金山專電（聯合新聞網轉載）指，輝達20日跌14.01%收125.53美元，報導引路透指與美國證管會調查其會計作業的消息有關；單日市值蒸發約4,900億美元，較歷史高點低約48.4%，連7週下跌累計跌46%。公司預估明年營收成長75%，但未止住賣壓。
summary.en: A CNA dispatch carried by UDN says Nvidia fell 14.01% on Nov. 20 to US$125.53, linked, citing Reuters, to reports of an SEC probe into its accounting. About US$490 billion of value was lost in a day; the stock is about 48.4% below its record and down 46% over seven straight weekly losses. Its forecast of 75% revenue growth next year did not halt selling.

impact.zh-TW: 證管會調查屬報導消息，結果未定；輝達股價波動與台灣AI晶片、伺服器供應鏈情緒高度連動，屬推論。
impact.en: The SEC probe is a report with no outcome yet; Nvidia's swings are closely tied to sentiment toward Taiwan's AI chip and server supply chain. This is an inference.

sources.publisher: 中央社 via 聯合新聞網 UDN

title.zh-TW: 美眾院揭露：川普政府核准近88萬顆AI晶片出口中企
title.en: House panel: Trump administration approved nearly 880,000 AI chips for Chinese firms

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，美國眾院外委會公布資料，2025年12月至2026年5月商務部核准輝達H200與超微MI325X約87.9萬顆出口中國企業，包括騰訊15萬顆、阿里巴巴7.5萬顆、百度4.3萬顆，委員會稱這些公司列於涉軍企業名單；實際出貨量不明。輝達表示許可受嚴格限制且已停止對中國出貨H200。
summary.en: CNA reports the House Foreign Affairs Committee released data showing Commerce approved about 879,000 Nvidia H200 and AMD MI325X chips for Chinese firms from Dec. 2025 to May 2026, including Tencent 150,000, Alibaba 75,000 and Baidu 43,000, which the panel says are on a military-linked list. Actual shipments are unclear; Nvidia says licences were limited and it has stopped H200 shipments.

impact.zh-TW: 揭露可能加大國會對AI晶片出口管制的壓力，管制若再收緊將影響對中出貨能見度；具體政策尚未定案，屬推論。
impact.en: The disclosure may raise congressional pressure for tighter AI chip export controls, which would cloud China shipment visibility; no new policy has been decided. This is an inference.

title.zh-TW: 川普：2至3年後或允許輝達Blackwell晶片賣中國
title.en: Trump says Nvidia's Blackwell might be sold to China in two to three years

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引彭博報導，川普在APEC期間受訪表示，若他仍在任且Blackwell已不是市場最先進產品，可能在「兩、三年」後允許其銷售中國，並稱輝達正在開發取代Blackwell的產品。報導指同週美國政府已加強多國處理器出口審查，限制中企遠端取得AI算力。
summary.en: CNA, citing Bloomberg, reports Trump said during APEC he might allow Blackwell sales to China in two or three years if he is still in office and the chip is no longer the most advanced, adding Nvidia is developing a successor. The same week the administration tightened processor export reviews to several countries to curb Chinese remote access to AI compute.

impact.zh-TW: 此為有條件的未來說法，並非政策決定；短期對中高階AI晶片管制仍偏緊，屬推論。
impact.en: This is a conditional future remark, not a policy decision; near-term controls on high-end AI chips to China remain tight. This is an inference.

reason.zh-TW: 台積電為輝達等AI晶片的主要代工廠，輝達股價重挫與對中出口管制動向可能牽動AI晶片需求情緒；報導未直接提及台積電，屬產業推論。
reason.en: TSMC is a key foundry for Nvidia and other AI chips, so Nvidia's slide and China export-control moves may sway AI chip sentiment; the reports do not name TSMC, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 權值比重高，易受外資賣壓與費半修正放大波動；管制收緊可能影響客戶對中出貨。
risk.en: Its heavy index weight exposes it to foreign selling and chip-index corrections; tighter controls may hit customers' China shipments.

reason.zh-TW: 鴻海為輝達AI伺服器組裝供應商之一，輝達會計調查報導與股價走勢可能影響AI伺服器族群情緒，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Hon Hai assembles Nvidia-based AI servers, so reports of an SEC accounting probe and Nvidia's slide may affect AI server sentiment, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 客戶資本支出調整、出口管制及交貨地點變化可能影響出貨；權值股易受法人賣壓。
risk.en: Client capex cuts, export controls and delivery-site shifts may affect shipments; as a heavyweight it is exposed to institutional selling.

reason.zh-TW: 廣達為AI伺服器代工大廠，輝達Blackwell平台出貨與AI資本支出疑慮相關；報導未直接提及廣達，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Quanta is a major AI server maker tied to Nvidia's Blackwell platform and AI capex sentiment; the reports do not name Quanta, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 雲端業者資本支出放緩或晶片管制變化可能降低需求能見度；毛利率偏低使評價易受修正。
risk.en: Slower cloud capex or chip-control changes could reduce demand visibility; thin margins make valuation sensitive to corrections.

reason.zh-TW: 日月光投控提供先進封測服務，與AI晶片需求連動；對中AI晶片出口審查與輝達賣壓可能影響族群情緒，屬產業推論。
reason.en: ASE provides advanced packaging and testing linked to AI chip demand; China export reviews and Nvidia selling may sway sector sentiment, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 出口管制擴大可能增加合規成本與客戶訂單不確定性；半導體修正延續將壓抑評價。
risk.en: Wider export controls may raise compliance costs and order uncertainty; a prolonged chip correction would weigh on valuation.

reason.zh-TW: 經濟日報指壽險業為主要借券出借者，金管會鼓勵出借機構暫停出借並召回；旗下國泰人壽為大型壽險公司，可能受出借收入及持股評價影響，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Economic Daily News says life insurers are the main stock lenders the FSC urged to halt lending and recall shares; Cathay Life is a large insurer that may see lending income and equity holdings affected, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 股市大跌可能壓抑壽險投資收益與資本適足；暫停出借將減少相關收入。
risk.en: A steep market drop may hurt insurers' investment income and capital adequacy; halting lending would cut related income.
